The structure of Yb4B8C4 (reduced formula YbBC2) adopts the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows B centers with two C neighbors at 1.524 Å, C centers with six neighbors (two B, one C, three Yb), and Yb centers with eight geometric neighbors (two B, six C). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between 6-vertex C polyhedra and corner- and face-sharing between 8-vertex Yb polyhedra.
